# Smart Click Media

> Digital marketing agency based in Harare, Zimbabwe, serving businesses across all 10 provinces and the Zimbabwean diaspora. Phone / WhatsApp: 0771 269 979 (+263 77 126 9979).

## Services

- [Digital Marketing](https://www.smartclickmedia.co.zw/services/digital-marketing/): One joined-up growth plan across search, social, ads, email and your website, built around sales, not likes.
- [Website Development](https://www.smartclickmedia.co.zw/services/website-development/): Fast, mobile-first websites that load on any network in Zimbabwe and are built to win enquiries.
- [SEO](https://www.smartclickmedia.co.zw/services/seo/): Rank on page one of Google for the searches your customers make, and stay there.
- [Paid Ads](https://www.smartclickmedia.co.zw/services/paid-ads/): Google, Meta, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn ads managed for profit, not vanity clicks.
- [AEO (AI Search Optimisation)](https://www.smartclickmedia.co.zw/services/aeo/): Get your brand recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.smartclickmedia.co.zw/services/social-media/): Strategy, content, community management and social listening across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn.
- [Local SEO & Google Business Profile](https://www.smartclickmedia.co.zw/services/local-seo/): Show up on Google Maps and "near me" searches in Harare, Bulawayo and every town you serve.
- [E-commerce](https://www.smartclickmedia.co.zw/services/ecommerce/): Online stores with local payments, plus the ads, emails and automations that make them profitable.
- [Email & WhatsApp Marketing](https://www.smartclickmedia.co.zw/services/email-whatsapp-marketing/): Newsletters, lead nurturing and automated WhatsApp and email flows that sell while you sleep.
- [Lead Generation & CRM](https://www.smartclickmedia.co.zw/services/lead-generation-crm/): Lead-gen systems, call tracking and CRM setup (such as Pipedrive or HubSpot) that connect marketing to sales.
- [Conversion Rate Optimisation](https://www.smartclickmedia.co.zw/services/cro/): UX audits and A/B testing that turn more of your existing visitors into customers.
- [Analytics & Tracking](https://www.smartclickmedia.co.zw/services/analytics/): GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking and live dashboards so every decision is backed by data.
- [Content Marketing & Link Building](https://www.smartclickmedia.co.zw/services/content-marketing/): Articles, guides, video scripts and digital PR that build authority with Google, AI and your buyers.
- [Hosting, Maintenance & Speed](https://www.smartclickmedia.co.zw/services/hosting-maintenance/): Secure hosting, backups, updates and speed optimisation so your website never lets you down.
